title: SkyrimNet Acheron Integration
tagline: Downed-state bridge between Acheron defeats and SkyrimNet/Baka.
description: Connects Acheron's defeat-and-hold system to SkyrimNet: delegated downs route through Acheron.DefeatActor, downed NPCs emit cues and reminders, creature hand-off and auto get-up are configurable, and Acheron-side rescue events feed back into SkyrimNet triggers. Folded into the unified Delectatio et Dominium build; this layer carries the two framework-side triggers (acheron_downed, acheron_recovered) whose narration was invisible to the content library until REV-104.
author: around906
